title: Startup Critical Path, Providers, and Main-Thread Blocking Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies startup critical path, providers, and main-thread blocking?
options: Remove nonessential dependencies from the startup critical path rather than merely changing their thread.
Use splash time as extra budget
questions.answer: Remove nonessential dependencies from the startup critical path rather than merely changing their thread.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Work on a background thread cannot delay startup.
questions.explanation: Launching initialization on Dispatchers.IO and immediately awaiting it from the main thread preserves the same startup dependency and adds scheduling cost.

questions.prompt: Why inspect the merged manifest during startup work?
questions.answer: Libraries can contribute providers and components that initialise before the Activity and are absent from the app’s source manifest.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
